question: Which of the following keyboard shortcuts is used to display and hide the desktop in windows 10?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Windows logo key + D.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Windows logo key+D**

 
 
• **Windows logo key+D shortcut** is used to **display and hide the desktop in windows 10.**
 
• This command forces Windows to switch to the desktop immediately and minimize all open windows to the taskbar.
 
• We can use this same shortcut to bring back those open windows.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Shortcuts**

 
 
• **Ctrl+H shortcut** is used to **open the find and replace tool in word processors** that allow you to search for a word, character or phrase and you can replace it with something else. 
 
• **Windows logo key+H** shortcut is used **to share the content **if supported by the active app.
 
• **Ctrl+D shortcut** is used **to create a new bookmark** for the favourite for the current page.
